# WAS_CCA_base { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_base }

```python
WAS_CCA_base(
    n_modes=4,
    n_pca_modes=8,
    standardize=False,
    use_coslat=True,
    use_pca=True,
    dist_method='nonparam',
)
```

Canonical Correlation Analysis model based on xeofs.cross.CCA.

## Important: {.doc-section .doc-section-important}

- No detrend no extract_leading_eeof_component is used here.
- The CCA basis is entirely handled by xeofs.cross.CCA.
- The predictand is standardized before CCA in forecast/cross-validation,
  then transformed back to the original scale with reverse_standardize.
- Missing values are handled using training-period means to avoid leakage.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_base.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit) | Compute PB/PN/PA for the requested predictive distribution. |
| [calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_base.calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric) | Non-parametric probabilities from the historical residual sample. |
| [compute_prob](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_base.compute_prob) | Compute hindcast tercile probabilities with guaranteed output order. |
| [plot_cca_results](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_base.plot_cca_results) | Plot CCA spatial modes and canonical scores. |
| [preprocess_forecast_data](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_base.preprocess_forecast_data) | Prepare real-time predictor data for forecast. |
| [weibull_shape_solver](#wass2s.WAS_CCA_base.weibull_shape_solver) | Compatibility wrapper for the historical public helper. |

### calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_base.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit }

```python
WAS_CCA_base.calculate_tercile_probabilities_bestfit(
    best_guess,
    error_variance,
    T1,
    T2,
    dist_code,
    dof,
)
```

Compute PB/PN/PA for the requested predictive distribution.

### calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_base.calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric }

```python
WAS_CCA_base.calculate_tercile_probabilities_nonparametric(
    best_guess,
    error_samples,
    first_tercile,
    second_tercile,
)
```

Non-parametric probabilities from the historical residual sample.

### compute_prob { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_base.compute_prob }

```python
WAS_CCA_base.compute_prob(
    Predictant,
    clim_year_start,
    clim_year_end,
    hindcast_det,
    best_code_da=None,
    best_shape_da=None,
    best_loc_da=None,
    best_scale_da=None,
)
```

Compute hindcast tercile probabilities with guaranteed output order.

WAS_CCA_base.plot_cca_results(

Plot CCA spatial modes and canonical scores.

### preprocess_forecast_data { #wass2s.WAS_CCA_base.preprocess_forecast_data }

```python
WAS_CCA_base.preprocess_forecast_data(Predictor_for_year, Predictor_train)
```

Prepare real-time predictor data for forecast.

Missing values are filled using the historical predictor mean.
